versions.changelog:
Initial release of kimi-k3-subagent Python implementation:

- Provides two-stage batch scheduling, lifecycle management, and dynamic rate limiting for sub-agents.
- Event-driven architecture with SwarmEventEmitter for full agent lifecycle tracking.
- Ensures sub-agent results meet quality threshold (≥200 characters, with auto-completion).
- Includes support for several built-in agent types: coder, explore, plan, btw.
- Inspired by MoonshotAI/kimi-code; all major components available for immediate use.
